outputs.explanation: Panel A top shows a bar chart of Cell death (%) with mean±s.d. error bars only; no individual data points from the three independent experiments are overlaid on the bars.
Panel B shows a bar chart of Cell death (%) with error bars but no individual data points are shown overlaid on the bars.
Panel C shows grouped bar charts of Cell death (%) at multiple time points with mean±s.d., but no individual data points from the three experiments are overlaid.
Panel D shows a bar chart of Cell death (%) with error bars but no individual data points are shown overlaid on the bars.
